prompt.uz: Likvorning barcha porsiyalari bir xil intensivlikda qizil va 2 soatdan keyin ham rangi o‘zgarmaydi. Bu nimani ko‘rsatadi?
prompt.ru: Все порции ликвора одинаково красные, и через 2 часа цвет не меняется. О чём это говорит?
prompt.en: All CSF portions are equally red and the colour does not change after 2 hours. What does this indicate?

basis.uz: Haqiqiy eritrositarxiyada (qon quyilishi) barcha porsiyalar bir xil qizil va 2 soatdan keyin rang o‘zgarmaydi; soxtasida asosan 1-porsiya qizil va likvor tiniqlashadi.
basis.ru: При истинной эритроцитархии (кровоизлиянии) все порции одинаково красные и цвет через 2 часа не меняется; при ложной красная в основном 1-я порция и ликвор просветляется.
basis.en: In true erythrocytarchia (haemorrhage) all portions are equally red and stay red after 2 hours; in false erythrocytarchia mainly the first portion is red and the fluid clears.

prompt.uz: Davolashni kuzatishda ketma-ket notreponema testlari qanday bajariladi?

basis.uz: Ketma-ket testlar bitta usulda (VDRL yoki RPR), iloji bo‘lsa bitta laboratoriyada qilinadi: VDRL va RPR titrlarini bevosita solishtirib bo‘lmaydi, RPR titrlari ko‘pincha biroz yuqoriroq.

basis.en: Serial tests use one method (VDRL or RPR), preferably in one lab: VDRL and RPR titres cannot be compared directly and RPR titres are often slightly higher.

basis.uz: Urobilinogenni ichak bakteriyalari o‘tdagi bilirubindan hosil qiladi; u juda kam yoki yo‘q bo‘lsa — o‘t yo‘llari to‘silishi, jigar qon oqimi to‘silishi yoki jigar faoliyati buzilishi; gemolitik anemiyada esa urobilinogen oshadi.

basis.en: Gut bacteria make urobilinogen from bilirubin in bile; too little or none suggests a bile-duct blockage, blocked hepatic blood flow or liver dysfunction, whereas haemolytic anaemia raises it.
